zh: 文献卡接入 DOI 查询、Zotero 只读与本地材料引用。DOI 查询由宿主能力 literature.doi 完成：先规范化 DOI，再向 Crossref 取候选元数据，按规范化后的 DOI 缓存十分钟，人按刷新可跳过缓存；429 原样带回 Retry-After，404、请求失败与格式不对分开提示；联系邮箱只有卡片设置里填了合法地址才进查询串，不从身份或本机配置取。候选按字段逐项补入，已有内容要先点选替换，理解、问题、阅读条目与材料不受影响。Zotero 由 literature.zotero 只连本机 127.0.0.1:23119，默认关闭、在卡片设置里手动启用，库、分类、条目三级读取并预览，离线、403、超时与无匹配分别提示；导入只填空白字段，来源以提供方、库、条目 key、接口版本与读取时间写进文献的 external，外部版本与本地修订号分开。材料引用区分网页与本地路径，新增用途、设备标签、材料版本与核查日期；本地路径只存文本，可在界面复制，不交给 widget.open、不执行，也不扫描磁盘。materials.device 只报平台，不报主机名与用户名，设备标签由用户自己起名；换设备打开时提示路径不在本机。导出导入仍只带引用与路径文本，导入预览统计本地路径条数。记录规格、检索、模板与内置组件画廊同步覆盖。组件 manifest 因此新增可选 styles：样式可以拆成多份，按顺序接在 style.css 之后。
en: The literature card gains DOI lookup, read-only Zotero import and local material references. DOI lookup is a host capability, literature.doi: it normalizes the DOI, asks Crossref for candidate metadata, caches by normalized DOI for ten minutes and lets a manual refresh skip the cache; 429 passes Retry-After through while 404, request failures and malformed input are reported separately, and a contact email only joins the query when the card settings hold a valid one, never taken from identity or machine config. Candidates fill fields one by one; existing values need an explicit replace, and notes, questions, reading entries and materials are left alone. Zotero is literature.zotero, connecting only to 127.0.0.1:23119, off by default and enabled by hand in card settings; libraries, collections and items are read and previewed, with offline, 403, timeout and no-match reported separately. Import fills only empty fields and records the provider, library, item key, API version and fetch time in the literature record's external list, keeping external versions apart from the local revision. Material references now distinguish web links from local paths and carry a purpose, device label, material version and checked date; a local path is stored as text only, can be copied in the UI, and is never passed to widget.open, executed or used to scan the disk. materials.device reports the platform only, never the hostname or user name, and device labels are named by the user; opening on another device flags the path as not local. Export and import still carry references and path text only, and the import preview counts local paths. The record spec, search, templates and the built-in gallery cover the new fields. The widget manifest therefore gains an optional styles list, so styles can be split across files and appended after style.css in order.
